title: SOSV Deep Tech Live: Governance in the Age of AI — Eric in conversation with Po Bronson
summary: SOSV is a deep-tech venture firm whose Deep Tech Live series is aimed at founders. Eric spoke in San Francisco, with a parallel livestream on LinkedIn, arguing that frontier labs such as Anthropic have built governance guardrails while most early-stage startups still launch on boilerplate legal paperwork.
blockquote: Eric and moderator Po Bronson (General Partner at SOSV) will dig into Eric's blueprint for how startups can prosper and endure without losing their soul
attribution_title: SOSV's deep-tech founder series; moderated by General Partner Po Bronson
